meta.note: POLAND'S MINISTRY OF FINANCE LAYER, FIRST PASS. RESULT: 4 nodes, 3 dependencies, 2 dropped notes. The 2026-09-11 round could not reach www.gov.pl at all; this cloud container read it directly on 2026-10-24 (gov.pl pages and their /attachment/ PDFs, isap.sejm.gov.pl PDF downloads, and CELLAR for the EU act), with TLS verification on. Two Ministry documents are minted: the annual Public Finance Sector Debt Management Strategy, wired to the Public Finance Act its own first sentence names, and the Medium-Term Fiscal-Structural Plan 2025-2028, wired to the EU regulation its footnote 2 names and to NATO's defence-expenditure compendium its charts cite. The third document the handoff listed, the state budget execution report, is a lead in _dropped: its page was found and not read.

reports.title: Ustawa z dnia 27 sierpnia 2009 r. o finansach publicznych
reports.description: The Public Finance Act (Dz.U. 2009 nr 157 poz. 1240; consolidated text Dz.U. 2025 poz. 1483). Article 75(1) obliges the Minister of Finance to prepare a four-year strategy for managing State Treasury debt and influencing public debt, which the Debt Management Strategy names as its own basis. Title verified from the original Dziennik Ustaw text downloaded from ISAP (HTTP 200). Minted 2026-10-24 in the Ministry of Finance round.

reports.title: Strategia zarządzania długiem sektora finansów publicznych
reports.description: The Ministry of Finance's four-year Public Finance Sector Debt Management Strategy, prepared every year. The Minister presents it to the Council of Ministers for approval, and the Council presents it to the Sejm with the justification of the budget bill. Covers State Treasury debt, public debt under the national definition and general government (EDP) debt. Latest edition read: 'Strategia zarządzania długiem sektora finansów publicznych w latach 2027–2030' (Warsaw, September 2026, 72 pages). Minted 2026-10-24 in the Ministry of Finance round.
reports.cadence_note: Annual, each edition looking four years ahead ('czteroletniej (do 2009 roku - trzyletniej)', four-year, three-year until 2009), per the Ministry's own strategies page.

reports.title: Średniookresowy plan budżetowo-strukturalny
reports.description: Poland's Medium-Term Fiscal-Structural Plan under the EU's reformed economic governance framework: the net expenditure path, the general government debt projection and the reforms and investments behind them. The first edition covers 2025-2028 (61 pages; the PDF's own creation date is 8 October 2024). The plan itself says Member States submit one every four years; the annual implementation reports ('Sprawozdanie z wdrażania…') are separate documents, not minted here. Minted 2026-10-24 in the Ministry of Finance round.
reports.cadence_note: Every four years, as the plan's own introduction states for EU Member States ('co 4 lata'); 0.25 is that cycle written as a rate.

reports.title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1263 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 29 April 2024 on the effective coordination of economic policies and on multilateral budgetary surveillance and repealing Council Regulation (EC) No 1466/97
title_aliases: Rozporządzenie Parlamentu Europejskiego i Rady (UE) 2024/1263 z dnia 29 kwietnia 2024 r. w sprawie skutecznej koordynacji polityk gospodarczych i w sprawie wielostronnego nadzoru budżetowego oraz uchylające rozporządzenie Rady (WE) nr 1466/97
reports.publisher: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
reports.description: The preventive arm of the EU's reformed economic governance framework, under which each Member State submits a medium-term fiscal-structural plan. Both titles are the Publications Office's own: the English from CELLAR's English expression and the alias from its Polish expression (both HTTP 200 on 2026-10-24); EUR-Lex answers this container HTTP 202 with no body. The Polish alias is the official Polish title, which is how Poland's plan names the act. Minted 2026-10-24 in the Poland Ministry of Finance round.

dependencies.basis: SELF-DECLARED: RESEARCHED 2026-10-24. The 2027–2030 Strategy opens its Introduction by naming the Act and article it is prepared under: 'Zgodnie z art. 75 ustawy z dnia 27 sierpnia 2009 r. o finansach publicznych (…) Minister Finansów zobowiązany jest do opracowania co roku czteroletniej strategii zarządzania długiem Skarbu Państwa (SP) oraz oddziaływania na państwowy dług publiczny (PDP).' Art. 75(1) of the Act's own text, read from the Dziennik Ustaw original on ISAP, says the same. ROUTE: the Ministry's own PDF from gov.pl (HTTP 200, 72 pages), read in the cloud container with TLS verification on; quote verbatim, ending before the footnote marker. Grader 2026-10-24 (dry run, --edges): A, quote-found-artefact-named, naming title-run:7/10.

_dropped.edge: (state budget execution report, no node) -> pl-public-finance-act-2009
_dropped.why: LEAD, 2026-10-24. The third Ministry of Finance document HANDOFF §3 item 0b listed, the annual report on the execution of the state budget, lives at https://www.gov.pl/web/finanse/wykonanie-budzetu-panstwa, whose text says the Minister of Finance publishes 'sprawozdanie z wykonania ustawy budżetowej przyjęte przez Radę Ministrów' (the report on the execution of the budget act adopted by the Council of Ministers). The annual report PDF itself was not opened this round, so no node was minted. When it is, two edges are worth checking: its legal basis in the Public Finance Act, and `pl-nik-budget-execution-analysis` -> it, if NIK's analysis names the report by title.

LEAD, 2026-10-24. The Debt Management Strategy's Annex 3 describes rules of the Public Finance Act that index to 'wzrostu cen towarów i usług konsumpcyjnych ogłoszonego przez Główny Urząd Statystyczny za poprzedni rok budżetowy' (the prudential procedures above the 55% threshold). That is the Ministry describing the Act, not the Act's own text, and the provisions are later amendments not in the 2009 original. The consolidated text (Dz.U. 2025 poz. 1483) answered HTTP 403 from ISAP to this container, so the Act's own wording was not read and nothing was wired.
